messages:
Jordan: quick sync — revisiting model catalog compare UX. main asks: keep filters visible on entry, but collapse them into a compact pill when scrolling. also clarify perf badges and make pin copy friendlier. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/model-catalog
Sam: dug into the comps. idea: show full chips in top area, then when user scrolls down show a single "Filters (3)" pill on the sticky rail. clicking pill expands inline.
Maya (Product): i like that. concern: users might not notice the collapse. add a chevron + small label "Filters" so it reads like a control.
Devin (Eng): implementation note: virtualized table + sticky header can cause jumps. reserve the header height and use `position: sticky; top: 72px;` to avoid reflow.
Aria (Accessibility): the pill must be keyboard-focusable and announce state. use `aria-expanded` + `aria-controls`. when expanded, move focus into the first filter control.
Sam: badges: shorten visible text to "P99: 120ms" and add an accessible tooltip with full context and cost per M tokens as second line.
Maya (Product): copy tweak for pin: change from "Pin version" to "Pin for compare" and add microcopy under the version: "Pinned — kept in compare views".
Devin (Eng): pin action impacts prefs via api. do optimistic UI update and show inline toast on failure: "Pin failed. Retry" with retry button. also lazy-render tooltips to limit DOM at scale.
Aria (Accessibility): motion must honor `prefers-reduced-motion`. pin toggle should use `role=button` and `aria-pressed`. also don't rely on color alone; include icon + screen-reader text.
ui-bot: Preview for branch `catalog/compare-compact-pill` available: https://preview.redwood.ai/compare/preview-2043 (expires in 48h)
Jordan: next steps: sam to update figma w/ pill + chevron; aria to send a short a11y checklist; devin to prototype sticky header + optimistic pin flow; maya to finalize copy and telemetry. ship target: next minor (2 weeks).
